greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: A [Necromancer], yes — and before your hand drifts to that sword, no, nothing in this square has been raised. I merely occupy the cheapest air the Guild permits. Pisces Jealnv. You reek of a body that has never once held mana. Curious. You want something.

text_variants.text: Fewer eyes on me after dark. I prefer it that way — no one flinches until I am mid-sentence.
The pupil returns. Your channels are... adequate now. Do try not to embarrass the discipline in public.
Back again. Either you are braver than the Watch or you have reconsidered your ignorance. Which is it?
You have the look of someone who felt something they cannot name. I get that look often, usually right before someone asks me to explain it for free. Go on, then. Tell me what you sensed.
My other pupil. Say it quietly — the Watch counts my acquaintances. How fares the honest art?

text_variants._comment: 2026-07-26 spec 4 (Phase 6, Task 6.1): the three CONTEXTUALIZING reactions, one per lattice counter, appended in pilgrimage order under the last-match-wins contract so the most recent discovery is the one he opens with. He never assigns and never assembles -- each line reacts to a piece the REGION handed the player, and the picture waits for Act V.
text_variants.text: Ward-lore from a hedge witch. Do not make that face — hers is older than the Guild's and she FED hers too. That word keeps recurring.
Hedault read your frame unbidden and charged you nothing, which from that man is appetite, not generosity. I know the feeling. He is better at settings than I will ever be. Deny I said it.
A Drake forge taught you in an afternoon what my tuition has been circling for a month. They FEED their runes. Maintenance, they call it. I am revising my rates. Downward. Do not comment.

options.text: You're a mage. Teach me to cast.
You hold yourself like a swordsman, not a scholar.
Something's come through our pantry door. Will you look at it?
I read the wardwork myself: a spatial anchor, something that remembers being elsewhere.
I can read that dusty scroll now. A warding treatise — about a door.
About the pantry door — I understand what it is now. Where does that leave me?
I have the stone and Krshia's catalyst. Now what?
I found a second door down in that dungeon. Same runes as our pantry door.
The other art. The one you actually practice. Teach me.
I meant what I asked. Teach me the dead art.

options._comment: 2026-07-26 spec 4 (Phase 6, Task 6.1) THE SPINE START. Plan Task 6.1 Step 2 assumed door_awakened banks on a pisces_magic SURFACE; the shipped producer is sleep_beat.gd:142 (three study sleeps), so the attune-completion surface is this arm: the player reports the awakening the morning after Pisces told them to sleep on it (door_attune's own line), and the quest + spine_started ride the report. Spec 4 is explicit that the spine 'starts from Pisces at door_awakened', and the foreshadow copy is a SPOKEN line, so a code-side bank could not have carried it. Appended LAST so every cursor-pinned canonical over this hub is byte-identical (no shipped fixture carries door_awakened AND opens this graph -- checked all seven).
options.text: The Door woke. It reaches past Liscor now.

spine_start._comment: FORESHADOW, NEVER ASSIGN (spec 4 copy discipline): he names an appetite and a direction, no list, no errand. 'wardwork by the same hand' is the Act V seal, kept oblique -- the player has not been under this city yet.
spine_start.speaker: Pisces
spine_start.text: The Door will show you how far it wants to go. And somewhere under this city is wardwork by the same hand, still fed, still waiting. I intend to understand both. Go — see where it reaches.

second_door_bridge.speaker: Pisces
second_door_bridge.text: You found a second door. With the same runes. That is not a coincidence; that is a pattern, and patterns are the only honest language the dead leave behind. I should very much like to see it — after you have slept. Some findings deserve a rested mind.

options.text: I'll let you get back to it.

door_consult.speaker: Pisces
door_consult.text: A door that changes its mind about where it goes. How very like this city — even the fixtures have moods. Three ways to satisfy my curiosity: bleed for it, talk me into caring, or prove you can read a ward without my help. Choose, and do not waste my morning.

options.text: I'll clear whatever's coming through myself.
Come look at it yourself. Your kind of magic, not mine.
I'll read the wardwork myself, then.

consult_fight_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_fight_response.text: Bleeding it is. Predictable, but effective. Go on, then. I shall be here, dry and uninjured, exactly as planned.

consult_talk_pitch.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_pitch.text: You want me to walk into someone's pantry and grope at a wild ward with my bare senses. No. I have wards of my own I would rather keep.

options.text: It's not asking much. You'd know in a glance.

consult_talk_argue.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_argue.text: ...A glance. Hm. If it truly reads as spatial and not necrotic, I could examine it without touching a thing. Fine, for the intellectual insult of not knowing, not for you.

options.text: Then it's settled — I'll cover your time instead. (5 gold)

consult_talk_done.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_done.text: A spatial anchor. Crude. Fascinating. Whoever built your inn, adventurer, built it on something that remembers being elsewhere.

consult_skill_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_response.text: Read it yourself, then. [Observe] the frame close, and mind that the pattern does not repeat the same way twice. Report back if you actually understand what you saw. I shall judge whether you do.

consult_skill_report.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_report.text: ...Correct. Aggravatingly correct. You have the eye, if not the training. Do not let it go to your head. The training is where the real work is.

pisces_fence.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence.text: ...Observant. A rapier, in fact, before any of this. My father's trade — his grip, his footwork, his opinions on both. I set it down for magic, and he has yet to forgive either of us. The footwork stayed. It wins me arguments the diction loses.

pisces_fence_two.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence_two.text: I sold the blade years ago, when circumstances were... instructive. One does not miss a thing so much as the hands remember it. A sniff. Next question — preferably about magic, which unlike the past improves under examination.

lesson_mana.speaker: Pisces
lesson_mana.text: Then attend. Every living thing carries a reserve — mana. You will feel it as a second breath: a well that empties as you work a spell and refills when you sleep. A warrior spends stamina; you now spend this. Waste it and you are left waving your hands at the air.

options.text: How is casting different from swinging a blade?

lesson_casting.speaker: Pisces
lesson_casting.text: A sword asks only your arm. A spell asks your mind and your mana in the same instant: intent, shape, and cost, released together or not at all. Fumble any one of the three and you have merely gestured. Precision, traveler. Whatever the Watch mutters about my craft, it taught me precision.

options.text: So what do I cast first?

lesson_light.speaker: Pisces
lesson_light.text: [Light]. Always [Light]. It is cheap, it is obedient, and it fails without a corpse, a fire, or an inquest. Kindle one steady orb and you have proven the channel holds. Master that, and only then do we discuss the interesting spells.

options.text: I'm ready. Show me the words.

sealed.speaker: Pisces
sealed.text: There. The channel is opened — crudely, but opened. Sleep on it; the shape settles by morning, as these things do. And, traveler, when your first orb kindles, you will understand why I do not apologize for what I am.

door_recap.speaker: Pisces
door_recap.text: Then attend, because I dislike repeating myself. The door remembers being elsewhere; it wants an anchor to remember BY. East across the floodplains, well past the gate road, there is a seam of old dressed stone in the open grass — a ruin, collapsed and rude, but its plinth still cradles an anchor stone. Retrieve it. Krshia's resonant catalyst will attune the pairing. And do try not to die somewhere so architecturally disappointing.

options.text: East past the gate road. Understood.

door_recap_two.speaker: Pisces
door_recap_two.text: I have STANDARDS, not an itinerary. The Guild survey called it a seam and moved on; I call it a doorframe that lost its house. Go and prove one of us right.

door_attune.speaker: Pisces
door_attune.text: Then the scholarship is done and the tedium begins. Keep both near the door and REST. Attunement is not a lever, it is a residency — the frame learns the stone the way a house learns its family: overnight, and more than once. Sleep. Let the inn do the part no [Mage] can rush.

options.text: Sleep on it. Literally. Got it.

necro_deflect._comment: Two-visit deflect->teach per spec §5; the deflect option banks asked_about_necromancy and hides itself, which reveals the second ask on the next hub entry.
necro_deflect.speaker: Pisces
necro_deflect.text: No. — You mistake me: not 'no, never.' No as a complete sentence, which is more courtesy than this city has ever extended to my discipline. Necromancy is not a flourish one appends to a hobbyist's repertoire. It is the study they exile you for. Ask me again when you have decided you mean it.

necro_teach.speaker: Pisces
necro_teach.text: ...You are aware of what they call me in this square. You have heard the Watch's tone when my name comes up. And still you ask. Very well — sit. First principle: the dead do not mind. The living mind enormously, and you will learn to weather that, or you will quit. Bone answers a precise mind. Yours is nearly adequate.

necro_taught._comment: 'A fencer's trick first, a spell second' = the WB [Flash Step] teaching-beat callback (spec §5). 'Sleep will settle the argument' = diegetic bed signpost (#130 family).
necro_taught.speaker: Pisces
necro_taught.text: We begin with a dart of bone. Unglamorous, honest, and it has preserved my life more often than any duel. Your channels will fight the grammar of it; sleep will settle the argument. And — in time, if your footwork ever deserves it, I may show you the step that made me difficult to duel. A fencer's trick first, a spell second. When next we meet: fewer questions, better posture.

scroll_secret.speaker: Pisces
scroll_secret.text: Let me see that. Hm. Hmm. Whoever wrote this treatise anchored their wards the way I would — which is to say, correctly — and they were writing ABOUT your pantry. Do you understand? Someone documented that door before your innkeeper was born. It has been bound, fed, and waiting a very long time. I would call that ominous, if I were the sort to alarm people. I am. Be alarmed.

options.text: That's enough dread for one day.
